span.p:
Redis Cluster
ek IP pe 1000 log
-> login ke baad JWT se user_id: key rate:user_id:endpoint
1000 log ek IP pe = 1000 alag ginti (key = user_id)
office NAT, ek ki galti -> sirf uski ginti, 999 chalte
login se pehle -> user_id nahi, IP pe dheeli had + WAF
